products.name: Koraput, Odisha Honey Sundried Coffee
products.description: Single-origin HSD-process coffee beans from Koraput, Odisha. Balanced sweetness with a smooth, rounded body.

products.name: Koraput, Odisha Naturals Coffee
products.description: Single-origin natural-process (sun-dried cherry) coffee beans from Koraput, Odisha. Full-bodied with fruity, wine-like notes.

products.name: Koraput, Odisha Washed Coffee
products.description: Single-origin washed-process coffee beans from Koraput, Odisha. Clean, bright cup with well-defined acidity.

products.name: Dream Hill Koraput Coffee
products.description: Single-origin Arabica from Dream Hill Coffee's Saptagiri Plantation, Pottangi, Koraput - grown above 1100m for bright acidity and aromatic complexity rare in Indian coffee.

products.name: Brown Valley HSD Coffee
products.description: Single-origin honey sundried (HSD) coffee from Brown Valley Coffee Estate, Boipariguda, Koraput - balanced sweetness with a smooth, rounded body from a farm running full traceability by micro-lot.

products.name: Brown Valley Wild Civet Coffee (Kopi Luwak)
products.description: A genuine rarity from Brown Valley Coffee Estate, Koraput, Odisha - wild civet cat coffee (Kopi Luwak), wild-foraged (never caged) and hand-collected in small, seasonal batches.

products.name: Karadykan Estate Coffee
products.description: Single-estate Arabica coffee from Karadykan Estate, grown under native shade cover with a clean, aromatic cup.

products.name: Biccode Estate Coffee
products.description: Single-estate, washed-process Arabica SLN 795 from Biccode Estate - medium-intensity cup with lemon zest, cacao nibs, caramel and toasted notes.

products.name: Attikan Honey Sundried Coffee
products.description: Single-estate honey/sundried-process Arabica from Attikan Estate. Full-bodied with rich, syrupy sweetness and dried-fruit notes.

products.name: Attikan Washed Coffee
products.description: Single-estate washed-process Arabica from Attikan Estate. Clean, balanced cup with delicate floral and citrus notes.

products.name: Halflong Assam Coffee
products.description: Single-origin Arabica coffee grown in the hills of Halflong, North Cachar Hills, Assam. Mild acidity with a soft, earthy sweetness.

products.name: Filter Coffee (70% Arabica, 30% Robusta)
products.description: Our classic filter coffee Arabica and Robusta blend: 70% washed Arabica from Karadykan, Karnataka and 30% natural Robusta from Tirap, Arunachal Pradesh - aromatic and smooth, with a strong finish and good crema.

products.name: Filter Coffee (95% Arabica, 5% Robusta)
products.description: South Indian filter coffee blend of 95% washed Arabica from Karadykan, Karnataka and 5% natural Robusta from Tirap, Arunachal Pradesh - light, aromatic, and delicately sweet with just a whisper of crema-building strength.

products.name: Filter Coffee (90% Arabica, 10% Robusta)
products.description: South Indian filter coffee blend of 90% washed Arabica from Karadykan, Karnataka and 10% natural Robusta from Tirap, Arunachal Pradesh - smooth and fragrant, with a touch more body than a pure Arabica cup.

products.name: Filter Coffee (80% Arabica, 20% Robusta)
products.description: South Indian filter coffee blend of 80% washed Arabica from Karadykan, Karnataka and 20% natural Robusta from Tirap, Arunachal Pradesh - well-rounded and aromatic, with noticeably more body and crema than a lighter blend.

products.name: Custom Arabica Robusta Blend Filter Coffee
products.description: Build your own South Indian filter coffee blend - choose your Arabica/Robusta ratio (95/5, 90/10, 80/20, or 70/30) from washed Karadykan Arabica and natural Tirap Robusta.

products.name: Filter Coffee (70% Arabica, 30% Chicory)
products.description: Chicory Arabica filter coffee: 70% Arabica and 30% roasted chicory - smooth and mellow, with reduced bitterness and a classic finish.

products.name: Filter Coffee (Pure Arabica)
products.description: 100% pure Arabica filter coffee, ground fine for traditional South Indian filter brewing - no chicory, no blends.

products.name: Basic Black Coffee
products.description: An everyday, no-frills black coffee blend - smooth and balanced, easy to brew any way you like.

products.name: Vienna Roast Coffee
products.description: A medium-dark Vienna roast - a shade past classic medium, with caramelized sweetness and a smooth, rounded body.

products.name: French Roast Coffee
products.description: A bold French roast - dark, smoky, and full-bodied with minimal acidity.

products.name: x3 Coffee 75gm Packs
products.description: A curated trio of three of our coffees - a great way to explore different origins and roasts before committing to a full bag.

products.name: x5 Coffee 75gm Packs
products.description: A curated selection of five of our coffees - more variety for a deeper tasting flight.

products.name: x7 Coffee 75gm Packs
products.description: A curated selection of seven of our coffees - our biggest fixed sampler, built for serious tasting.

products.name: Pick Your Poison Sampler
products.description: Build your own sampler - pick up to 12 coffees yourself and choose your sample size.
